meta.title: Efficient Prompt Security Detection for LLM Service Deployment in Edge-Cloud Networks (BUUAS)
meta.venue: IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (TDSC), vol. 23, no. 5

problem.v: Edge-cloud prompt-injection detection ignores user/prompt heterogeneity, so detection is inefficient and leaves security gaps
problem.q: largely overlook the issue of user heterogeneity

main_idea.v: BUUAS: Bayesian-inspired per-user belief update + belief-weighted contextual bandit (BWCB) decides which prompts get edge-side DeBERTa detection vs a cheaper path to the cloud LLM
main_idea.q: Bayesian-inspired belief update method with a belief-weighted contextual multi-armed bandit

threat_model.v: Adversary controls prompt text only; no access to model parameters, detector or configuration. Attacks: hidden injection, role manipulation, jailbreak-style prompting
threat_model.q: adversary can fully control the textual content of input prompts

injection_types_covered.name: hidden prompt injection / role manipulation / jailbreak-style prompting (generic, via labelled prompt datasets)
injection_types_covered.q: hidden prompt injection, role manipulation, or jailbreak-style prompting

injection_types_covered.name: User behaviour patterns simulated (not injection techniques): Static-mal, Alt(1B-1M), Alt(2B-2M), Warm-up20, Warm-up30
injection_types_covered.q: persistent malicious attacks, denoted as Static-mal

limitations_stated.v: NOT FOUND (no limitations or threats-to-validity section; conclusion only)

limitations_inferred: [INFERENCE] Evaluation is on labelled prompt datasets with simulated users; no real LLM-app task and no measurement of whether an injection succeeded against a model
[INFERENCE] Edge and cloud are emulated on a single RTX 4090 workstation (Sec V-A), so no real network latency is measured
[INFERENCE] 70% of each dataset is stored in the retrieval index and 30% tested (p8): near-duplicate leakage inflates detection; cross-dataset test only in Table IV
[INFERENCE] The scheduler detects only a subset of prompts: its Accuracy (0.59-0.71) and F1 (0.48-0.75) in Table III are far below full detection and below GMDRA in Static-mal
[INFERENCE] Needs a GPU workstation and a vector DB (Milvus); not reproducible under our no-GPU constraint

reusable_for_our_project.v: Low priority as a method (GPU, simulated edge-cloud). Reuse the three public HF prompt datasets and the public detectors (protectai DeBERTa v2, TestSavant, Sentinel) as off-the-shelf detector candidates for our defense; cite as related work on adaptive detection scheduling
reusable_for_our_project.why: [INFERENCE] Same detector family as P03/P06; Table IV shows detector choice changes precision/recall trade-off
